basis.excerpt: Ultra is designed for applications demanding the highest reasoning accuracy for complex agentic tasks.
basis.note: apiId is null: no hosted-API model id was captured; the Hugging Face repo id is given instead. Newer Nemotron 3.5 Super VL / Bolt models exist (Oct 2026) but NVIDIA positions Ultra for highest reasoning accuracy.

description: NVIDIA's Nemotron family consists of open models with open weights, training data and recipes; its top tier, Nemotron 3 Ultra, is a 550B-parameter (55B active) hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE reasoning model with up to 1M-token context.

contextWindow.note: Serving examples default to 256k; up to 1M configurable.

openWeights.excerpt: the training data used for these models, as well as their weights, are open and available on Hugging Face

knowledgeCutoff.excerpt: * The post-training data has a cutoff date of May 2026. * The pre-training data has a cutoff date of September 2025.
knowledgeCutoff.note: Two data cutoffs stated (pre-training and post-training).
